items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: The bass player on the name is Jim, Jimmy. But I forget Jimmy's other name.

ctx.x: I've been, I've been around in that neighborhood some, now that I think about it, but probably not, you know, to know people. Who was his bass player at that time? Do you remember his name? From up in that neighborhood?
The bass player on the name is Jim, Jimmy. But I forget Jimmy's other name.
Was it Jimmy Johnson? I don't know if you called it. He was a good bull man. I've heard a lot of people talk about him. Mm-hmm. You know, a lot of the younger fellas that have met him.
